description: A small brown cardboard box sits on a green-covered table, with a tiny teddy and a pink plush nearby. The left hand steadies the box while the right hand flips the lid open, then the right hand reaches inside to lift out a small yellow duck and set it on the table; the right hand also plucks a small square insert from the box and places it to the right, then returns to adjust and press down on the white case inside as the left hand keeps the box in place.
